title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00039 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
11:00 - 11:15: Performed TBT for skidding operations
11:15 - 11:45: Removed access stairs to cantilever skidded cantilever to well f-12.
11:45 - 12:15: Installed access stairs to cantilever meanwhile removed hatches.
12:15 - 12:30: Built scaffolding around hatches. Installed hole covers on well f-14
12:30 - 13:15: Lowered nt2 connector from drill floor. M/u same onto multibowl. Meanwhile installed master bushing and BX-ELEVATOR.
13:15 - 13:30: Performed TBT for m/u BHA and RIH with inner string.
13:30 - 14:45: P/u and RIH with cutter BHA
14:45 - 15:00: P/u and m/u multibowl RT. RIH and engaged RT to multibowl. Confirmed by pulling 20 ton overpull.
15:00 - 15:15: Load shifted weight from tension cylinders to TDS. Meanwhile performed TBT for r/d tension cylinders
15:15 - 16:15: R/d tension cylinders
16:15 - 17:15: Removed boat collision stool and centralizers.
17:15 - 17:30: Built scaffolding around hole opening.
17:30 - 18:00: Pulled 20 ton overpull. Increased flow in steps to 2600 LPM 87 bar. Cut riser. Observed loss of overpull, good indication of cut.
18:00 - 19:00: R/d hoses and valve outlets from multibowl.
19:00 - 19:15: Performed TBT with ongoing crew.
19:15 - 19:45: Pulled riser and inner string to drill floor. Installed c-plate and landed off riser. R/b multibowl RT
19:45 - 20:15: Installed false rotary. Pulled and r/b inner string. R/b cutter BHA.
20:15 - 20:30: P/u and m/u multibowl RT. R/d c-plate.
20:30 - 21:00: Pulled tensioner joint above rotary table. Landed off riser onto elevator.
21:00 - 22:00: R/u cutting machine cut tensioner joint. Significant wave height 1,2 m r/d cutting machine.
22:00 - 22:15: Performed TBT for l/o multibowl and tensioner joint.
22:15 - 22:45: L/o mutlibowl and tensioner joint Removed multibowl and nt2 connector.
22:45 - 23:30: Pulled upper pup joint and splash zone joint. Cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck.
23:30 - 00:00: R/u cutting machine cut riser. Significant wave height 1,4 m
